name: Avisaurus
sum: Large enantiornithine from the Maastrichtian Hell Creek Formation of North America known from foot bones.
holotype: A tarsometatarsus of A. archibaldi up to 73.9 mm long from the Hell Creek Formation (number in Brett-Surman and Paul 1985).
material: The holotype and a referred tarsometatarsus.
biology: One of the largest known enantiornithine tarsometatarsi; Atterholt et al. (2018) compared its foot with those of birds of prey.
author: Brett-Surman and Paul 1985
